acceptanceCriteria: All supported active project and Phase 03 artifacts use canonical schemas.
Every active logical artifact has one synchronized Markdown/JSON pair with matching identity, revision, status, relationships, and payload hash.
Runtime active discovery accepts canonical schemas only and imports no migration-only parser.
Artifact registry contains exactly one authoritative revision per active artifact.
One workflow-state index covers Capture -> Frame -> Plan -> Build -> Prove.
Every routed screen uses one authoritative routed-action contract.
Reference navigation cannot override any routed target.
Role gates are enforced across all process categories.
State advances only after canonical pair and registry success.
Active report storage is Implementer_Reports and active report names use IMPLEMENTER_REPORT_.
Active runtime code, UI, schemas, generated prompts, and documents contain no legacy role aliases.
Legacy parsing and legacy-role-name recognition exist only in migration code and migration manifest.
Migration manifest records every migration, rename, archive, authority block, and resulting artifact identity.
Current WC08 Architect Review completes in-app and transitions to Operator Validation.
Architect and Implementer packets save inclusion/exclusion manifests and token estimates.
Over-budget packet export requires explicit acknowledgment.
data.commitMessage: Stabilize cross-process workflow and artifact authority

excludeByDefault: Permanent rules already in AGENTS.md or VALIDATION_COMMAND_LANES.md
implementerContents: Applicable architecture and UI contract references
Estimated token count and largest contributors
contextPacketRequirements.overBudgetPolicy: Warn, identify contributors, and require explicit Operator acknowledgment before export.

governingDecisions.artifactPair: Markdown and JSON are synchronized representations of one logical artifact revision generated from one typed payload.
governingDecisions.migrationOnlyLegacySupport: Legacy schemas and Implementer names may be recognized only inside one-time migration code and the migration manifest.
governingDecisions.revisionModel: One authoritative pair per logical artifact; increment revision and use Git history; no active _2/_3 revisions.
governingDecisions.terminology: Implementer is canonical. Legacy role terminology and legacy report storage paths are removed from active runtime and active artifacts.

migrationScope: Project intake, Architect interview, planning, reconciliation, roadmap, phase map, approvals, and observation registers.
Phase intake, Architect interview, planning, Work Card Plan, approvals, and observation registers.
Work Cards and repair Work Cards.
Implementer Reports, Architect Reviews, Validation Reports, and Route Review Requests.
Closeout, roadmap-update, and activation artifacts where present.
All active paths and relationships affected by Legacy-to-Implementer renaming.
outOfScope: Completion of every later route-specific form
Direct ChatGPT, Codex, MCP, connector, or provider API invocation
Runtime legacy schema or legacy role aliases
productConstraints: Do not redesign Capture -> Frame -> Plan -> Build -> Prove.
Preserve the compact Current Action panel and center-workspace ownership.
Artifacts remains the only artifact browser and preview surface.
Do not grant the Implementer unapproved visual or navigation authority.
data.purpose: Stabilize the complete Capture -> Frame -> Plan -> Build -> Prove lifecycle with canonical workflow authority, synchronized Markdown/JSON artifact pairs, repository migration, Implementer-facing role terminology, and bounded Architect/Implementer context packets before additional route-specific work.
requiredArchitecture: Canonical versioned artifact envelope for every durable workflow artifact.
Canonical artifact registry with exactly one authoritative revision per active artifact.
Canonical workflow-state index across project, phase, implementation, review, validation, repair, closeout, roadmap, and next-phase activation.
One typed routed-action contract used by presentation, workspace selection, form initialization, source selection, preview, save, and post-save transition.
Cross-process role gates for Operator, Architect, Implementer, and application responsibilities.
One canonical artifact-pair writer and verification service used by all active artifact-writing workflows.
One-time deterministic repository and Legacy-to-Implementer migration.
Bounded Architect Context Packet generator with token estimate and inclusion/exclusion manifest.
Bounded Implementer Execution Packet generator with token estimate and inclusion/exclusion manifest.

stabilizationEscalation.decision: Do not create WC08-REPAIR07. Absorb the unresolved WC08 route into WC09 migration and stabilization acceptance.
stabilizationEscalation.operatorOutcome: The governed Architect Review action remains unusable in the application.
stabilizationEscalation.requiredEndToEndProof: Open current WC08 action, enter Architect Review, bind authoritative Implementer Report, preview, save, and transition to Operator Validation.

terminologyMigration.activeCodeAndSchemaTerms: Rename legacy role schema fields, types, functions, IPC channels, renderer APIs, form labels, prompts, headings, validation text, and documentation to Implementer-facing role terminology.
